# WattsonBot

> Real-time Tesla vehicle monitoring delivered to Telegram. Instant alerts for charging, battery level, tire pressure and drive events — no extra app to install, no dashboard to check.

WattsonBot connects to a Tesla vehicle using a read-only refresh token (never the account password) and sends notifications straight to a Telegram chat with @WattsonEVBot.

## Pricing
$5/month, one plan, covers one Tesla with unlimited alerts, stats, and history on demand. Cancel anytime from Telegram with /billing.

## Features
- Real-time charging alerts (start, stop, target reached)
- Low-battery and range warnings
- Tire pressure (TPMS) alerts
- Drive start/end summaries with location and energy used
- Stats and history on demand via Telegram commands
- Configurable per-channel notification settings

## Security
Uses a Tesla refresh token, not the account password. The token grants read-only access to vehicle data — it cannot control or drive the car — and can be revoked at any time from the Tesla account.
